deadline.value: Central scholarship rounds: the international Round 1 (31 August) for starts by end of March 2027 has already closed. The next is Round 2, closing 15 April 2027 (year inferred) for starts by 31 August 2027; it is typically a smaller round. Admission applications are open all year.
deadline.quote: The application deadline to be considered in Round 1 (commencement of study in following year) is 31 August. The application deadline to be considered in Round 2 (commencement of study in same year) is 15 April.

also.quote: Round 2 has a deadline of 15 April and is typically a smaller round with commencement or take up of the scholarship up to the end of August of the same year.

supervisor.value: Admission requires the written approval of an identified supervisor, so contact potential supervisors before applying.
supervisor.quote: Have the written approval of an identified supervisor for the research project/thesis.

also.quote: Once an academic supervisor has been confirmed to support your application you may proceed to step three. | If you are not sure which area of research or supervisor matches your interest please complete an expression of interest and we will get in contact with you.

funding.value: Scholarships are competitive and an offer of admission does not guarantee one; first-class honours may generally be needed. The RTP stipend is AUD 40,475 a year (2027 base rate). International tuition is AUD 58,925.00 a year (indicative).
funding.quote: in general first class honours might be required for consideration for a scholarship. Scholarships are highly competitive and not all applicants that receive an offer of admission to a HDR program will be successful in receiving a scholarship. | Annual indicative fee for international students | $58,925.00

entry_route.value: A relevant bachelor's honours degree with at least Second Class Honours, Upper (H2A), or the international equivalent, or an equivalent mix of qualifications and research publications. No rule on 3-year vs 4-year Indian degrees is stated.
